title: Iris morphometrics

gates.name: n explicit and unit-defined
gates.evidence: n is recorded per outcome (e.g. n=158) and per group, but the independent unit is not declared in the input.
issues: independent unit not declared: no --unit-key given; the row is assumed to be the independent unit, and every test below inherits that assumption
gates.fix: pass --unit-key with what one row represents, or record it in the run manifest; the report already marks this AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED.

gates.name: missing data mechanism declared
gates.evidence: 2 variable(s) carry missing values and 2 have no declared mechanism.
issues: AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED: missingness mechanism for: sepal_width_cm, petal_width_cm
gates.fix: record collection context and a justified assumption; a small missing fraction or an association screen cannot establish it.

gates.name: effect size accompanies p
gates.evidence: all 4 estimable tests carry an effect size with a 95% CI.

gates.name: uncertainty visible
gates.evidence: every descriptive statistic carries an SE, every comparison figure states its interval, and every prose p value sits beside a CI.

gates.name: multiple comparisons corrected
gates.evidence: BH correction over a family of 4; 4 adjusted p value(s), all finite. Raw and adjusted values are both reported.

gates.name: sensitivity tested
gates.evidence: 64 perturbation(s) ran across 4 outcome(s) (leave-one-group-out, block jackknife, extreme-value fence, strict complete cases) and every one agreed with the primary verdict at alpha=0.05. Appendix A1 reports them.

gates.name: no association-to-mechanism upgrade
gates.evidence: no forbidden construction appears outside a disclaimer (11 patterns checked across 467 lines).

gates.name: unknowns flagged
gates.evidence: every unknown the pipeline detected is written AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED and repeated in Appendix B (unit undeclared).

structural.detail: all 3 figure(s) carry title, caption and a three-part body
0 forbidden phrases in the writer's own scan
